evidence_scope: notional and model-conditioned unless explicitly analytic

integrity.cycle4: diagnostic only because frozen input hashes did not all match
integrity.cycle5: all frozen inputs matched; independent-seed replication completed
integrity.cycle6: all frozen inputs matched; preregistered temporal and admission experiment completed
integrity.cycle7: all frozen inputs matched; preregistered three-block hurdle experiment completed

decisions.claim: A single dynamic next-generation attack score outperforms static spectral baselines.
decisions.binding_failure: Dynamic score was worse on MAE, AUC, Brier, robustness, and dependency ablation.
decisions.next_action: Retire as a scalar replacement. Retain dynamic layers as features or state variables.

decisions.claim: A training-selected temporal scalar outperforms pre-response non-backtracking.
decisions.binding_failure: Training selected propagator growth, which increased held-out MAE by 20.5 percent.
decisions.next_action: Do not use one training-selected scalar for both outbreak occurrence and final size.

decisions.claim: Reflected multi-resource overload index Omega_A transfers across scale and profile shape.
decisions.evidence_class: analytic construct plus model-conditioned preregistered confirmatory
decisions.status: not supported under fixed rule; strong provisional signal
decisions.primary_metric: Omega AUC 0.992; AUC delta 0.058; Brier improvement 0.506
decisions.binding_failure: AUC superiority was below 0.08 and only three of five robustness blocks met the full block rule.
decisions.next_action: Calibrate resource work and capacities from a real control plane, then run prospective external validation.

decisions.claim: A fixed two-stage model improves held-out mean final compromise prediction across independent blocks.
decisions.status: not supported under fixed rule; mixed positive evidence
decisions.primary_metric: Pooled MAE improvement 0.188; 95 percent interval 0.088 to 0.292
decisions.binding_failure: Only one block exceeded 15 percent improvement and Brier noninferiority held in only one block.
decisions.next_action: Keep phase separation, replace the initiation calibrator, and validate on measured attack traces.

overall_conclusion: No universal fleet assurance law or deployment architecture is established. Single scalar compromise predictors are ruled out in the tested forms. Omega_A and phase-separated compromise prediction remain research candidates, not validated operational controls.
highest_priority_external_validation: Measure assurance work per admitted agent, resource capacity, wait budgets, attack-path layers, incident propagation, detection, and containment timing on a real system.
